## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; sector returns mixed with Energy/Technology/Materials ahead while Financials/Utilities/Real Estate lag, supporting a neutral regime with mixed signals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong alongside big tech winners: MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: Financials sector down 1W; JPM (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND but sector overall weak. Utilities/Real Estate lag: VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.18% | 1M: -7.77%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +19.93% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TRAEND, NOW (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +18.32%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.92% | 1M: +18.14%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk; style: Growth/Momentum tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select staples, utilities and some large-cap tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +19.93% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence present (≥3 major names with 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical, not core.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed but positive 1W overall: MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation inside tech with concentrated winners.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials soft 1W but selective strength: JPM (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +4.42%) TREND EXHAUSTION — sector under pressure despite pockets of strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare constructive: LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND — defensive names mixed but several leaders confirming.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to select Energy and Tech winners given momentum (XOM, MPC, MSFT, NVDA) and reduce exposure to weak staples/utilities (CVS, VST) and concentrated tech laggards; style: Growth/Momentum tilt but be selective due to narrow leadership and divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.62% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +8.94%) showing Sector Strength relative performance. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -4.28%) showing Sector Weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
PLTR near short-term breakout continuation (ABOVE TREND) to monitor; NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND support/resume on 1M confirmation; CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND breach — watch for follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MPC (+55): Marathon Petroleum Q2 beat aligns with price MPC (1W: +7.62% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MA (+50): Mastercard services revenue beat versus MA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +4.42%) TREND EXHAUSTION — sentiment positive but short-term momentum mixed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CVS (-70): Political scrutiny headlines match price CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. UNH (-55): Political scrutiny mirrors UNH (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. PLTR (-45): Michael Burry short note vs PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging (distribution risk to monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated tech winners and Energy strength. PLTR (ABOVE TREND), SHOP (ABOVE TREND) and NEM (ABOVE TREND) are showing the strongest relative strength. Major divergence across large caps (META, AMZN, TSLA patterns) and bearish headlines on CVS/UNH are key risks to monitor.
